caseNameFull: JOHN D. PEDERSON v. United States

opinions.text:
Patents; suit for breach of patent license contract to pay royalties on rifle inventions; right of Court of Claims, after-finding patent infringement, to deny validity of patents for want of invention; deprivation of property by seizure of in*690ventions for public use without compensation. Petition dismissed.

Plaintiff’s petition for writ of certiorari denied by the Supreme Court March 15, 1948.
